title: Planet Tweaks V3.4.0 - Master Low-Latency Stability & Independent Audit Release

(2) Zero-Latency Input Stack: Full Peterbot & Pure Zero Delay optimization with native FilterKeys (0ms delay, Flags 27), stock 100 MouseDataQueueSize, and non-destructive CapsLock remapping. (3) Purged Unstable Tweaks: 100% removed 1ms HidUsb registry forcing, 8000Hz USB peripheral unthrottle, Dynamic Tick bcdedit modifications, and all duplicate/conflicting USB suspend entries. (4) Total Mojibake Elimination: Complete sanitization across all UI labels, cards, and metadata. (5) 26 Automated Verification Tests passing with 0 build errors across Public and Private editions.
